limitations: One trial per case, sequential DeepSeek then Qwen, no randomized crossover or confidence interval.
Warm caches; initial 154.6s local smoke probe is outside scored results.
11 first-pass Qwen requests and one retry were rejected by gateway before any model response.
Unknown root cause of gateway no_healthy_model; native chat health returned ok. No service restarted or production configuration changed.
One shared agent with model changed between batches; context disabled; per-model/per-case data prefixes prevent cross-case contamination.
Tool schemas and system prompt are the existing agentd ones; many task prompts intentionally constrain output and name the required operation. Results are not a broad autonomous-agent benchmark.
No forced malformed output, injected transport timeout, MCP, sandbox, web or schedule coverage. Approval workflow is not applicable.
Schema accuracy is not full semantic argument accuracy. Task outcome completion permits recovered mistakes and additional output; clean_completion separately records process deviations.
Only returned response usage is summed; incomplete model requests may incur unreported tokens.
No trustworthy tariff obtained; API monetary cost is null. Local monetary cost, resource utilization and peak memory were not measured.
Deployed agentd commit could not be verified through available access.
